hooks.name: no-print-statements
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); CONTENT=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.content // ""'); if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.py$ ]] && printf '%s' "$CONTENT" | grep -qE 'print\('; then echo 'Warning: print() statements should be replaced with logging' >&2; exit 2; fi; echo '{}'

hooks.name: black
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.py$ ]]; then black "$FILE" >&2 || echo "black skipped" >&2; fi; echo '{}'

hooks.name: isort
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.py$ ]]; then isort "$FILE" >&2 || echo "isort skipped" >&2; fi; echo '{}'

hooks.name: flake8
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.py$ ]]; then command -v flake8 >/dev/null 2>&1 && flake8 "$FILE" >&2; fi; echo '{}'

hooks.name: mypy
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.py$ ]]; then command -v mypy >/dev/null 2>&1 && mypy "$FILE" >&2; fi; echo '{}'

hooks.name: log-notifications
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); mkdir -p ~/.gemini; echo "Gemini CLI notification: $(date)" >> ~/.gemini/notifications.log; echo '{}'

hooks.name: flake8-changed
hooks.command: cat >/dev/null; if command -v flake8 >/dev/null 2>&1 && git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR | grep '\.py$' | xargs -r flake8 >&2; fi; echo '{}'

hooks.name: mypy-changed
hooks.command: cat >/dev/null; if command -v mypy >/dev/null 2>&1 && git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR | grep '\.py$' | xargs -r mypy >&2; fi; echo '{}'
